pattern.description: The cursor clicks the Integration item in the nav drawer: the active-row highlight jumps from Dashboards to Integration in a near-instant state change.
pattern.why_premium: A real, crisp UI state change on the exact word 'actuals' shows the click path without any extra graphics; the instant swap keeps a demo feeling responsive rather than staged.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.timeline().set('.nav-item.dashboards', {backgroundColor: 'transparent'}).set('.nav-item.integration', {backgroundColor: '#0b2a6b'}); optionally a 0.08 s fromTo on the integration row backgroundColor with ease 'none' for a press flash; no stagger.
build_hint.remotion: Step change: const clicked = frame >= clickFrame; dashboards row background = clicked ? 'transparent' : activeColor; integration row background = clicked ? activeColor : hoverColor. No spring; at most a 2-frame interpolate on backgroundColor via interpolateColors.

notes: No SFX candidates despite a click; the cursor barely moves (it is already over Integration from e008).
